verdict.rationale: Terraform's own docs show that configurations are human-readable files meant to be versioned. Changes can be reviewed before execution via `terraform plan`, including saved plan files, JSON plan output and policy checks, and a community comment corroborates the value of execution plans. However, versioning relies on an external VCS, and no first-party rollback capability is documented; state modification commands are only adjacent. missing for 10: documented rollback/revert of applied changes, native version history of automations, independent hands-on corroboration of a version-review-rollback workflow.
